sentences.text: I brush my teeth two times each day.
My dog runs fast to catch the stick.
The big truck drives down the main road.

On Easter, Dad asked if I wanted to see a famous steam train. I was happy to accept! The train was made of strong steel and gave a loud whistle, like a big voice. We waited in line, and the staff let us stand at the front. I did a double take when I saw how huge it was. What a chance to see a real steam train up close!

Dad and I learn about space at night. We watch the stars appear one by one. The moon looks like a big round stone in the sky. I ask Dad many questions, and we learn together. One day, I hope to travel among the stars!
The shop is closed so we go home.
The train runs fast on the long track.
I bought a new toy at the store.

Hooray, it was games day! First, we had a ball throw, and I threw mine as far as I could. Then I stood at the start of the race with the other kids. I followed the track all the way around the course. I came third last year, but this time I was faster! I kept going until the finish. Of all my times, this was my best. On days like these, I feel super!

I heard a funny sound behind the door. I was not afraid so I looked inside. My cat got stuck in the basket! I set it free and it ran round the room. Then it fell asleep beside me on the chair. Mum and dad laughed when I told them that night.
I keep all my stuff in one big box.
I take a deep breath and jump in the lake.
I feel tired after a long day.

Mum and I make a sweet treat in the evening. We add sugar, milk, and some honey. The whole house smells so good! We get Dad to taste the treat. He says, "Thank you." My tummy is happy after the yummy treat. We share the rest with the family.

I heard a funny sound behind the door. I was not afraid so I looked inside. My cat got stuck in the basket! I set it free and it ran round the room. Then it fell asleep beside me on the chair. Mum and dad laughed when I told them that night.
Few plants grow in the hot dry desert.
My mum takes the most direct road home.
Can you do me a small favour, Dad?

I wrote a letter to my friend who lives far away in the south. I told her every detail of my active week and one funny thing that happened at school. I made sure to spell each word right. At the bottom, I drew a funny face. I told her I would like to speak to her soon. I am still waiting for her letter to arrive. When it comes, I will hold it tight!

I read a thick book about wild animals. Here are three facts I never knew! A fox can hear a mouse under the snow. Some birds can fly for many hours. An owl can turn its head very far around! I am always learning new things about animals.
I write a letter to my dear friend.
I stand in the centre of the circle.
The famous band plays on the big stage.

Each week, we walk around our town. We stand in the centre and hear the church bells. We choose a couple of apples and buy some bread. A woman sells cotton hats in many colours. My father buys one for a dollar. This is common for us, and we enjoy our day together.

We take a train to visit my uncle today. I watch the land speed by from my seat. There are soft clouds above and wide fields below. My uncle waits for us with a big smile. He tells us a story about a friendly dragon. I think it is the best story in the world!
I pick a bright flower for my mum.
I learn a French word from my uncle.
I like the style of my new red coat.

I study my spelling words until I know them well. Mum checks each answer as I go. I almost forget one word, but then I get it right! It takes energy to learn, but I do not give up. I expect to do my best in the test. Bit by bit, I get better.

Our class went to see old art. We saw Indian art and art from Africa and Europe. A guide called us over to a tall stone column. Part of it was in a broken state. She showed us a figure on it and told us about its length and design. I was amazed by the amount of work it took. We honour the past when we learn about it.
I think these young birds will sing until dark.
My dad reads me a story before bed.
The tiny chick became a big white bird.

My dreams get bigger every year. I love to create new things at my table. Today, I decide to make a toy boat. I do not always depend on a plan. I just try my ideas and see what works. That is my usual way. I have many bright ideas for the future!

A fluffy young dog became our pet a few years ago. At first, he was afraid and tried to run away. One day, I left the door open by mistake. I knew it was wrong, and I was sorry. He ran out, but Dad caught him just in time! Anyway, we did not give up. We spend time playing with him each day, and soon he learned to stay close. Those years have been filled with fun and love. He is now an actual member of our family and brings us total joy!
I ate a couple of sweet red apples.
I visited the doctor and now I feel better.
There are many wild animals in the world.

I want to become a doctor for pets one day. While I play, Mum teaches me how to care for my toy dog. I touch its paw gently and change the cloth on its leg. I make a clean bed where it can rest. Good health can start with simple care. Mum even shows me a trick to keep the cloth in place. I learn that anyone can help others. Indeed, I value being kind and caring.

Dad tells me that Grandma grew up on a small French island. When she was young, she helped gather food from the farms while others went fishing or worked nearby. Boats came each week to trade fish and other goods. People on the island shared what they had, so everyone had enough. Grandma’s story has a warm effect on me. I ask which part she loved best. “Either the sea or the trees,” she says. One day, I hope to visit her island too.
